# What Does Bloomerang Really Cost?

Based on the search results, Bloomerang costs depend on which product you're interested in:

## Individual Products (Monthly, Billed Annually)

- **Bloomerang CRM**: Starting at **$125/month** ($1,500/year)
- **Bloomerang Fundraising**: Starting at **$40/month** ($480/year)
- **Bloomerang Volunteer**: Starting at **$119/month** ($1,428/year)

## All-in-One Bundle

- **The Giving Platform** (all three products integrated): **$524/month** - Contact sales for exact pricing

## Key Cost Factors

**Base pricing is determined by:**
- Number of records/contacts in your database
- Which products you choose

**What's included in all plans:**
- Unlimited users
- Free email & chat support
- Access to Bloomerang Academy
- Various standard features (donor scoring, email marketing, address verification, etc.)

## Real-World Pricing

Reviewers note that the **effective base cost is around $300/year**, though this varies based on database size. Some organizations may pay more if they add:
- Training services
- Premium support
- Additional features during sales demos

**Important note:** There is **no free trial or free version** available.

For nonprofits, Bloomerang is generally described as an affordable option with reasonable value for the features provided, though you should verify exact pricing based on your specific contact database size.
